correctness.rationale: The neighborhoods are explicit. Their two families give subcomplexes \(X\) and \(Y\) that collapse separately to \((n-2)\)-spheres, while \(X\cap Y\) is exactly the connected crown graph \(K_{n,n}-M\) with cycle rank \(n^2-3n+1\). For \(n\ge4\), \(X\) and \(Y\) are simply connected, so the two inclusions of the graph intersection are null-homotopic. The simplicial inclusions are cofibrations, and the homotopy-pushout formula yields exactly the claimed wedge. Exact finite chain calculations for \(4\le n\le8\) independently reproduce the predicted Betti ranks.

value.rationale: The family \(L(K_{2,n})\cong K_2\square K_n\) is a canonical infinite family of line/rook graphs. The result turns neighborhood complexes with \((n-1)\)-dimensional facets into an exact mixed-dimensional wedge with two persistent \(S^{n-2}\) summands and a quadratic \(S^2\) multiplicity. The crown graph appears naturally as the gluing locus, giving a structural explanation rather than an isolated finite computation.
